item.title: Cheap but high quality: NFA assures standards for P20/kilo subsidized rice
item.description: NFA Northern Mindanao assures the public that the "Benteng Bigas" sold at P20 per kilo in Misamis Oriental meets high quality standards. Sourced locally at P33/kilo and subsidized by the government, the rice is reserved for low-income households, PWDs, and senior citizens. Governor Juliette Uy highlighted that rigorous inspections have solved previous quality concerns, with distribution now active for qualified residents at the NFA office in Tablon. item.title: Millennials and the future of governance
item.description: PHILIPPINE GOVERNANCE — As a generational handover unfolds, tensions rise between seasoned supervisors and Millennial staff. Critics cite "instant quitting," yet younger employees offer tech mastery and an impatience with corruption. The future of the bureaucracy depends on active mentorship—habits formed today will define leadership and public policy for decades. item.title: Oro adopts 4-day workweek to conserve energy
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO — Mayor Rolando Uy has officially implemented a four-day compressed workweek for City Hall employees as a strategic move to reduce energy consumption amid rising global fuel costs. Following Memorandum Circular No. 114, city offices will now operate from Monday to Thursday, extending daily hours until 7:00 PM, with Fridays designated as non-working days. item.description: CAMIGUIN — Governor Xavier Jesus Romualdo has launched a provincial crackdown on fuel overpricing, flagging 19 gasoline stations for exceeding the Department of Energy's (DOE) allowable price range. Following reports of diesel being sold for as high as P83 per liter in Sagay—well above the permitted P49 to P69 range—the Governor issued Executive Directive No. 17. item.title: Bagets: Nostalgia of high school life
item.description: TARALETS, Bagets! Bagets is a Filipino slang term for teenagers or young people, often implying they are energetic, trendy, or slightly inexperienced. It is a colloquial, shortened term derived from “bagito” (new/young) with a plural “s” used to describe the youth generation. item.title: Uy targets up to 20% reduction in power, fuel consumption
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO — Mayor Rolando “Klarex” Uy’s Executive Order No. 103-26 shifts City Hall to a four-day workweek (Monday–Thursday, 8 AM–7 PM). Targeting a 20% energy cut, the policy mandates 24°C thermostats and virtual meetings. Essential services like J.R. Borja General Hospital remain fully operational despite the new schedule.
